name: kalshi (API Evangelist profile)
what_it_holds: Independent third-party documentation profile of Kalshi's public REST/WebSocket API surface (endpoints, auth, market/order/position data availability) rather than any data or client code.
why_useful: Useful as an API-surface reference to scope what event categories (economics, weather, sports — regulation/travel not confirmed) Kalshi actually exposes before investing in a puller.

name: prediction-market-arbitrage
what_it_holds: Analyzes Kalshi, Polymarket, and PredictIt via API pulls plus ML-based text matching to find cross-platform market-title equivalents and mispricings; reports a backtested 9.41% mean ROI over 75 matched opportunities (Jul-Aug 2025).
why_useful: Brings PredictIt into the cross-platform matching picture (a third, older prediction-market venue with historically more political/regulatory questions), and the title-matching ML code is reusable for finding any ABNB- or travel-adjacent contract across all three venues.

name: awesome-prediction-markets
what_it_holds: Second awesome-list covering exchanges (Kalshi, Polymarket, Metaculus, Manifold, PredictIt, Smarkets, Futuur, Insight Prediction), official/unofficial API+SDK links per platform, MCP servers, aggregators (SimpleFunctions, MetaForecast, Oddpool, BaseRateTimes), a 'Data & Datasets' section (live orderbook/context feeds and historical settlement/subgraph/export pointers), and a macro-data section (FRED, World Bank, BLS, IMF, Eurostat, OECD).
why_useful: Points to cross-platform aggregators (MetaForecast, Oddpool, BaseRateTimes) that already normalize Metaculus/Manifold/Polymarket/Kalshi/GJ-Open questions — useful starting points for pulling any ABNB-earnings-adjacent or travel/regulation forecasting questions in one place rather than per-venue.

name: metaforecast (now in Squiggle monorepo, apps/metaforecast)
what_it_holds: Aggregator that fetches and indexes forecasts/questions from Metaculus, Manifold Markets, and other platforms into a searchable Postgres database with a GraphQL API and a manualDownload.js script; no committed data files or DB dump in-repo. Archived (read-only) since 7 Mar 2025; source moved to the Squiggle monorepo (apps/metaforecast). MIT licensed, 622 commits.
why_useful: A cross-platform question/forecast search index (GraphQL) spanning Metaculus + Manifold (and historically other venues) that could surface ABNB-earnings, travel-demand, or STR-regulation questions without hand-querying each platform's own API; the manualDownload script is a plausible one-command pull method even though the hosted DB itself is not archived in-repo.
time_coverage: Active period of the aggregator; archived Mar 2025
last_activity: Archived 7 Mar 2025 (622 commits); superseded by Squiggle monorepo

name: forecasting-tools
what_it_holds: Official-adjacent Metaculus framework (78 stars) for building an AI forecasting bot against Metaculus tournaments/questions; includes Python tooling and API documentation for pulling Metaculus question metadata and community-prediction history programmatically.
why_useful: A maintained Python client/framework for pulling Metaculus question and community-forecast history (including any macro, travel, or company-earnings-adjacent questions) as an acquisition method, complementing the team's existing forecast-methods harness.
